name: attribute-editor
purpose: An editable list of rows with the same fields, after Cloudscape's attribute editor: key and value pairs (environment variables, headers, metadata) or any set of columns given by a `definition`. It owns the row anatomy every hand-built editor repeats: a label per cell, one control per cell, a per-cell error under the field, Add and Remove, an item limit, the empty text, focus after add and remove, and a polite announcement of each change. A grouped mode lays rows out as AND groups joined by OR, the shape of rule criteria. It edits an array and validates nothing itself: the consumer passes `errors`.
useWhen: Users add, edit and remove a variable number of pairs or tuples: environment variables, request headers, query arguments, labels, metadata.
Rule criteria: conditions inside a group must all match (and), groups are alternatives (or).
A bulk form where each row has the same two to four fields and a row-level error can occur.
avoidWhen: Key and value tags with limits, reserved prefixes and removal of saved tags → use `tag-editor`, which is built on this component.
A fixed set of named settings on one resource → use `field` controls in a form.
Many records the user browses, filters and acts on → use `table` with row actions.
An ordered list of actions with drag and drop and per-type arguments → compose it by hand as in the `platform/edit/rule-builder` block.
related: tag-editor` — key and value tags with limits and validation, on top of AttributeEditor.
field` — every cell is a `Field` with its label, control and error.
input` — the default control of a cell; any control can replace it through `cell-<key>`.
separator` — the "or" between groups in grouped mode.
platform/edit/rule-builder` (block) — its criteria are this component in grouped mode (AND rows inside a group, OR between groups), with a `Combobox` variable cell.
bestPractices: Keep two to four columns; more columns belong in a drawer per row.
Pass `errors` only after the first Save (rule of the form-error block), then keep them live while the user fixes the rows.
Use `minItems: 1` when the form needs at least one row, so the last row keeps its fields and loses its Remove.
Set `limit` when the backend has one; the component says how many rows are left and disables Add at the limit.
Replace a cell's control through `cell-<key>` (a `Select` for an operator, a `Switch` for secret) instead of drawing rows by hand; use `row` only when the row needs a layout of its own.

Type the rows with your own interface (`ref<Header[]>`): `value` in `cell-<key>` and `item` in every slot then carry the field types, so a `Select` or `Switch` binds `value` without `as string` / `as boolean`.
Name the editor (`ariaLabel`) after what the rows are: "Environment variables", "Request headers".

props.name: items
props.doc: Rows in list mode. Supports v-model:items.

props.name: groups
props.doc: Rows in grouped mode: every inner array is an AND group, groups are joined by OR. Supports v-model:groups.

props.name: definition
props.doc: Columns of every row: key of the item field, label, placeholder, required.

props.name: errors
props.doc: Error per cell, aligned with the rows (nested per group in grouped mode). Empty shows none.

props.name: addButtonLabel
props.doc: Label of the Add button. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: removeButtonLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the Remove button, followed by the row number. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: addGroupLabel
props.doc: Label of the Add group button in grouped mode. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: empty
props.doc: Text shown when there are no rows. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: limit
props.doc: Most rows allowed (per group in grouped mode); Add is disabled at the limit and the rows left are announced.

props.name: groupLimit
props.doc: Most groups allowed in grouped mode.

props.name: minItems
props.doc: Fewest rows kept; rows at the minimum lose their Remove button.

props.name: newItem
props.doc: Builds a new row. Unset creates an item with an empty string per column key.

props.name: itemRemovable
props.doc: Hides Remove on the rows it returns false for. Unset makes every row removable.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size of the default controls and the Remove button, on the 28 / 32 / 40 rhythm.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables every control, Add and Remove.

props.name: addDisabled
props.doc: Disables Add only, for example until the last row is filled in.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the list of rows.

events.name: update:items
events.notes: A row was added, removed or edited in list mode.

events.name: update:groups
events.notes: A row or group was added, removed or edited in grouped mode.

events.name: add
events.notes: After a row is added; `groupIndex` only in grouped mode.

events.name: remove
events.payload: { index: number; item: TItem; groupIndex?: number }

slots.name: row
slots.scope: { item, index, groupIndex, errors, update, remove, removable, removeLabel }
slots.notes: Replaces the whole row; the column header is not drawn.

slots.name: row-actions
slots.scope: { item, index, groupIndex, remove, removable, removeLabel }
slots.notes: Replaces the Remove button at the end of a default row (for example Remove / Undo that marks a row instead of deleting it).

slots.name: actions
slots.notes: Extra buttons after Add (for example Upload or Paste .env).

slots.name: info
slots.notes: Extra help text under the buttons, after the limit text.

slots.name: limit
slots.notes: Replaces the limit text in list mode (for example "You can add 3 more tags.").

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import AttributeEditor from '@aziontech/webkit/attribute-editor'
  import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

  const definition = [
    { key: 'key', label: 'Key', placeholder: 'MY_VARIABLE', required: true },
    { key: 'value', label: 'Value', placeholder: 'my-value' }
  ]

  const items = ref([
    { key: 'API_BASE_URL', value: 'https://api.example.com' },
    { key: 'max uploads', value: '25' }
  ])

  const errors = computed(() =>
    items.value.map((item) => {
      if (!item.key.trim()) return { key: 'Key is required.' }
      if (!/^[A-Z0-9_]+$/.test(item.key))
        return { key: 'Use only uppercase letters, numbers, and underscores.' }
      return undefined
    })
  )
</script>

<template>
  <AttributeEditor
    v-model:items="items"
    :definition="definition"
    :errors="errors"
    :limit="10"
    :min-items="1"
    add-button-label="Add variable"
    remove-button-label="Remove variable"
    aria-label="Environment variables"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Grouped
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import AttributeEditor from '@aziontech/webkit/attribute-editor'
  import Select from '@aziontech/webkit/select'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const definition = [
    { key: 'variable', label: 'Variable' },
    { key: 'operator', label: 'Operator' },
    { key: 'argument', label: 'Argument', placeholder: '/api/' }
  ]

  const operators = [
    { value: 'is-equal', label: 'is equal' },
    { value: 'starts-with', label: 'starts with' },
    { value: 'matches', label: 'matches' }
  ]

  const groups = ref([
    [
      { variable: '${uri}', operator: 'starts-with', argument: '/api/' },
      { variable: '${request_method}', operator: 'is-equal', argument: 'POST' }
    ],
    [{ variable: '${host}', operator: 'is-equal', argument: 'admin.example.com' }]
  ])

  const newItem = () => ({ variable: '${uri}', operator: 'is-equal', argument: '' })
</script>

<template>
  <AttributeEditor
    v-model:groups="groups"
    :definition="definition"
    :new-item="newItem"
    :limit="10"
    :group-limit="5"
    :min-items="1"
    add-button-label="Add condition"
    add-group-label="Add OR group"
    remove-button-label="Remove condition"
    aria-label="Criteria"
  >
    <template #cell-operator="{ value, update }">
      <Select
        :model-value="value"
        size="medium"
        @update:model-value="update"
      >
        <Select.Trigger />
        <Select.Content>
          <Select.Option
            v-for="operator in operators"
            :key="operator.value"
            :value="operator.value"
            >{{ operator.label }}</Select.Option
          >
        </Select.Content>
      </Select>
    </template>
  </AttributeEditor>
</template>
